units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 26a:2">Ab. Zar. 26ᵃ</cite> there was among them <he>חד גר׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>גיר׳</he>) one weaver.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 26a:2">Ib.</cite> <he>ג׳ דלא טייזן</he>, v. <cite ref="I00339"><he>טַיְיזָן</he></cite>. [Var. <he>גרדן</he>, <he>גרדנאי</he> in Rashi a. l., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 90.]

senses.gloss: scabby, afflicted with an itch.—Pl. גַּרְדָּנֵי, גִּירְ׳.
